استحقوا (form X)
# اِسْتَحَقُّوا (istaḥaqqū) /is.ta.ħaq.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# اُسْتُحِقُّوا (ustuḥiqqū) /us.tu.ħiq.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# اِسْتَحِقُّوا (istaḥiqqū) /is.ta.ħiq.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
